title: Stranded by a booker in Jackson, Mississippi, over New Year's 1939
summary: A broke promoter books the band in Mississippi on nerve; a country club New Year's Eve job pays their bills and gets them home.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: But that was back in '38. Benny Goodman came through here -- was it '38 or '39?
'39. And she stayed with us for --
Well, she was with us -- '38 going we were down in into '39, she was with us when (inaudible) Mississippi, you know.

She sure did. Because the band toured -- the band came out of the Plantation during the holidays, And we went to Arkansas and all down through Mississippi. And they booked us down in Jackson, Mississippi. And we like NOT got out of Jackson, Mississippi.
What happened?

Well, the promoter booked us down there on nerve, and he didn't have no money. And didn't draw no crowd. So we worked around there and finally contacted some country club there, and we -- they needed a band on a New Year's Eve night.
They got disappointed.
Huh?
I said, they got disappointed.
They got disappointed, you see. So
they hired our band and we made enough money to pay up all our bills --
And get out of town.
-- and get out of town and get on back into St. Louis.
That was another one of the incidents at the Plantation, where a fellow we worked with his son manage the band, so you know there was no hanky-panky. But this booker that we had -- what's his name?
Perry.
Perry.
Perry.
He's our man, I believe he's out of Little Rock now, but he booked the band on nothing.
He died a few years ago.
Oh, he did?
He died about five years ago.
After he got rich.
Well, he was a four flusher. He drove big cars and he made folks think he was rich, but he wasn't rich. But that's another story.
Uh-huh. Meridian, Mississippi.
Meridian, Mississippi.
Jackson.
Jackson. Those were two towns in
Mississippi, and did we play Pine Bluff? No. Huh?
No.
We just played Little Rock. Played a couple of dates in Little Rock. That took us through '39 into '40. Am I right?
